Every other operation stays allowed. Gate processes (VerificationRunner), h9k task run-local, and the Windows spawn path are unchanged.\u0022,\u0022The PID the daemon records is still the agent\\u0027s own PID for its whole life (the existing exec chain is kept), so the stream file, SessionResultWaiter, and TerminateTree behave exactly as before.\u0022,\u0022A test, using only sleep processes ended by PID, proves under the profile the daemon actually generates that a process in the sandbox can signal a child it detached with \\u0060( sleep \\u2026 \\u0026 )\\u0060, that it cannot signal a sleep started outside the sandbox (Operation not permitted), and that the outside sleep is still alive afterwards. No test runs pkill, killall, kill -1, or any pattern or glob in a kill or rm.\u0022,\u0022If sandbox-exec is missing or the profile fails to apply, the dispatch fails closed: the run does not start, and the failure names the containment as the reason. A node setting set through h9k config set turns containment off, defaulting to on, and h9k daemon status shows its live value.\u0022,\u0022A decision event records the boundary: it covers any signal from the session or anything it starts, including detached and re-grouped processes; it does not cover Docker, launchctl, Apple Events, file writes, or Windows. It names the known incompatibility (anything inside a session that applies its own seatbelt sandbox fails with Operation not permitted: Chrome with its sandbox on, Claude Code\\u0027s own sandbox setting, swift build without --disable-sandbox; Playwright\\u0027s --no-sandbox default is confirmed and stated). It records that Claude Code\\u0027s built-in sandbox, Codex, and srt call the same sandbox-exec, so the deprecation risk is shared, not avoided; that the vendor sandbox was set aside because headless Chromium cannot start under it on macOS (Claude Code issue 82660); and that moving to it is the planned exit, triggered when Chromium launches under it with --no-sandbox.\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022A dispatched session\\u0027s own cleanup command killed processes it never started: a pattern-first pkill on macOS SIGTERMed about 64 of the operator\\u0027s apps (ntss-platform task 44ecd7f4, 2026-10-09 11:05).
